voices.note: the Sages of this mishna, disputing R' Yehuda

props.gloss_en: one who traps a bird into a migdal is liable
R' Yehuda: and [one who traps] a deer into a house is liable
the Sages: [one who traps] a deer into a garden is liable
the Sages: ... or into a courtyard -- liable
the Sages: ... or into enclosures (bivarin) -- liable
Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel: not all enclosures are alike [-- liability for the enclosure is only where the capture is not lacking]
this is the principle: [trapping that is still] lacking capture -- exempt
[trapping that is] not lacking capture -- liable

supports.gloss_en: זה הכלל -- liability turns on whether the capture is still lacking, so enclosures differ
